detail.longDescription:
Network Analyzer Pro is a complete, ad-free network toolkit that turns your phone into a powerful diagnostic instrument. Whether you are troubleshooting a slow connection, securing your home Wi-Fi, tracking down unknown devices on your network, or exploring how the internet routes your traffic, it puts a professional-grade set of tools right in your pocket - no desktop or extra hardware required.

Scan nearby Wi-Fi networks to find the least-crowded channel and boost your signal, discover and identify every device connected to your LAN, measure your real download and upload speeds, and diagnose any host with ping, traceroute, port scanning, DNS lookup, and whois. From curious home users to IT professionals who depend on fast, accurate results every day, Network Analyzer Pro delivers everything you need in one polished app.

Wi-Fi signal meter:
- Both graphical and textual representations showing network channels and signal strengths
- Channel usage graph - see per-channel utilization
- Frequency bands 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz
- Wi-Fi network type (WEP, WPA, WPA2, WPA3)
- Wi-Fi encryption (AES, TKIP)
- BSSID (router MAC address), manufacturer, WPS support
- Channel bandwidth
- Information elements such as theoretical maximum speeds

LAN scanner:
- Fast and reliable detection of all network devices
- IP addresses of all discovered devices
- NetBIOS, mDNS (Bonjour), LLMNR, and DNS name where available
- Reachability (ping) test of discovered devices
- IPv6 availability and discovered IPv6 addresses
- Wake on LAN (WOL) including remote WOL
- Scan of custom IP ranges
- Filtering and search in the discovered device list

Ping & traceroute:
- Round-trip delay including IP address and hostname for every network node
- Geolocation data including latitude, longitude, country, city, and time zone
- AS number and network name information
- Complete traceroute visualization on the map
- Graphical ping statistics updated in real time
- Both IPv4 and IPv6 - selectable

Port scanner:
- Fast, adaptive scanning algorithm
- Detection of closed, firewalled, and open ports
- Description of the known open port services
- Scan common ports, the complete range, or a custom port list
- Both IPv4 and IPv6 - selectable

Whois:
- Look up domains, IP addresses, and AS numbers

DNS lookup:
- Functionality similar to nslookup or dig
- Support for A, AAAA, SOA, PTR, MX, CNAME, NS, TXT, SPF, SRV records

Internet speed:
- Test of both download and upload speeds
- Graphical speed test view
- Speed test history

Network information:
- Default gateway, external IP (v4 and v6), DNS server, HTTP proxy
- Geolocation of the external IP including country, city, and coordinates
- Wi-Fi network information such as SSID, BSSID, IP address, subnet mask, signal strength, etc.
- Cell (3G, LTE, 5G) network information such as IP address, signal strength, network provider, MCC, MNC, etc.

Local service discovery:
- Bonjour service browser
- UPnP/DLNA service and device browser

More:
- No ads
- Light and dark theme
- Full IPv6 support everywhere
- History of all performed tasks with the ability to star favorites
- Export and share by email and more
- Copy/paste support
- Detailed help
- Regular updates, support page
